descriptions.en: A Home Assistant custom integration that connects to a KOCOM Smart Home+ wallpad to retrieve household energy metering data.
descriptions.ko: **코콤 스마트홈+** 월패드에 연결해 세대 **에너지 검침 정보**를 가져오는 Home Assistant 커스텀 통합구성요소입니다.

categories_review.source: Reviewed by docs implementation on 2026-10-22: README metering-only scope and custom_components/kocom_smarthome/{coordinator,sensor,models}.py expose household electricity, heating, hot water, gas and water readings, apartment averages and estimated charges from a wallpad/apartment server. Primary category energy.meters_monitoring matches the actual meter-monitoring purpose; lighting/outlet/heating control is unsupported. Taxonomy: hass-repo-standards/scripts/standards/integration_categories.json at 0ec31111a81b0ee5702f1d8a17f03616a10a5db6. No secondary category needed.
